_doc: v1_blend.py: seam = |x| of the arm roots' wall against the V plate; probe = how far outboard the root's height is read; above = how far the plate's edge ends above that (overlap); x0 = |x| where the plate starts rising; skin = depth below the top that counts as top skin; under = how far below the root the plate stays past the wall; corner = the plate's rear corner at the seam pulled back by dy (falloff radius, only behind y + front)
